title: Personal Checking: early closure fee and window by tier
content:
## Scope

A Personal Checking owner who closes the account soon after opening it may owe an early closure fee. This card lists each tier's fee and the number of calendar days after the opening date during which a customer closure incurs it.

## Early closure terms by tier

| Tier | Early closure fee (USD) | Early closure window: calendar days after the opening date |
|---|---|---|
| Access Checking | 0.00 | 90 |
| Student Checking | 0.00 | 90 |
| Everyday Checking | 25.00 | 90 |
| Interest Checking | 25.00 | 90 |
| Premier Checking | 25.00 | 90 |
| Private Client Checking | 25.00 | 90 |

## Basis Q&A

**Q: Which tiers carry an early closure fee?**
A: Everyday, Interest, Premier and Private Client Checking, at 25.00 USD. Access Checking and Student Checking show 0.00.

**Q: Is the window the same length on every tier?**
A: Yes, 90 calendar days after the opening date on all six tiers.

**Hypothetical contrast**: two owners each close an account 40 calendar days after opening it, one on Student Checking and one on Premier Checking. Both closures fall inside the 90-day window, but only the Premier Checking figure is above zero, at 25.00 USD.
